title: Home guide: which materials reflect light best?
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Forces, magnets and light (Mighty Metals and Why Do Cat's Eyes Glow at Night?)
source: Written for science/y3 lesson 16 (Home practical guide and safety card: torch and reflective materials (portal worksheet))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out which materials reflect light best.
equipment: Foil, white paper, black fabric, a metal spoon and cardboard
safety: Never shine the torch into anyone's eyes
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Shine the torch on each material from the same distance.
Score how bright it looks: 1 (dull) to 5 (very bright).
